snippet.title: Action indie game《AirBoost Airship Knight》on Steam, with a planned release in 2025.
snippet.description:
Developed by the Taiwanese indie game team FilterGame,
the girl-centric story action game AirBoost: Sky Knights has launched its Steam page today,
along with a brand-new trailer!
